description: Stable Chrome reports loadDataSource 'system', so there is no per-tab load data and the Browser Load gauge cannot be shown. The sidebar footer must therefore render NO gauge wrapper at all - only the footer's own top hairline separates the tab/group counts and the Import/Export link. An empty wrapper would contribute a second border-bottom hairline and a dead click target sending the user to the Load page.
